transcript.text: You have your first big loss and how do
you recover? By putting the guardrails
back on. But going back to one trade a
day for a week, just until you've
smoothed back out. I imagine being in a
rowboat. And a big loss is like all of a
sudden I hit a rock and there's a giant
hole in the boat. So the first thing I
have to do is stop the bleeding. I've
got to stop the water from coming in. So
I've got to plug this hole. That's the
first thing. Stop losing. The next step
is to start bailing yourself out. But
there's no sense bailing yourself out
when you're still digging a hole deeper.

metadata.title: WHAT TO DO AFTER A BIG LOSS
